lead.headline: Pickens is yours and plays tonight; Tuten is still on the bench
lead.deck: The claim went through at 01:25 and cost the priority: you are last in the order now. He is in the flex, where the projection puts him. One swap is left before Sunday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Saquon Barkley did not practise on Wednesday, the official report now confirms it, and Ian Rapoport expects him to miss the London game. Alvin Kamara, on your bench, sat out with a sore back. Bhayshul Tuten, 3.1 above Ollie Gordon by projection, is on the bench for the fourth edition running. And the claim that landed overnight cost exactly what it was priced at: you were 7th of ten in a waiver order that never resets, and you are 10th now. The claim itself is the news. George Pickens for Josh Downs processed at 01:25. Wednesday's edition said it would probably fail, and it was wrong about that: six managers ahead of you passed on Dallas's second receiver. He has no injury designation, Dak Prescott is healthy, and a second search found nothing reported that explains why he was dropped. He plays tonight at 18:15 against Tampa Bay, who start an undrafted rookie at quarterback and have been stingy to receivers, fourth-fewest points allowed in standard scoring. You already have him in the flex, 13.3 to Matthew Golden's 12.7, which is the projection's call and a coin flip, so there is nothing to change before kickoff. As set you project 115.8 against 123.3 and ESPN gives you 46% against Kings of the North, whose Tee Higgins missed practice and whose Jeremiyah Love was limited. The move left is the old one. Start Tuten in the RB slot Gordon holds, before 07:30 on Sunday. He is not on Jacksonville's injury report and Jacksonville are favoured by a touchdown. With the priority gone, the lineup is where the remaining points are.
